A2.basis: New mission, no workbook source; written per docs/plans/new-mission-playbook.md, angle distinct from sdg4-1 (STEM/exam pressure) and sdg4-2 (digital equity/media literacy): the status and outcomes of vocational/technical education specifically. Facts and sources: vocational-school enrollment share fell from 59.6% (98th academic year) to 46.68% (112th academic year), a 16-year low; ratio was 7:3 forty-plus years ago; academic track overtook vocational in the 108th academic year; by the 113th academic year, general-track students ~279,000 (down 11,000) vs vocational students ~210,000 (down 52,000) (udn.com, CNA reporting Ministry of Education statistics, 2024-2025). Stigma ('black hands'/blue-collar label vs 'craftsman'/'technician' respect elsewhere) and parental credential-insistence even alongside direct-to-job tracks (Global Views Monthly, Liberty Times, CNA, 2024-2025). WorldSkills 2024 (47th, Lyon): Taiwan 58 competitors/50 trades, 2 gold/3 silver/10 bronze/28 excellence, 4th of 69 countries (Ministry of Labor press release Sep 2024, via udn.com/TBO Taiwan). WorldSkills Asia 2025 (Taipei, hosted by Taiwan): back-to-back overall team champion, 17 gold/9 silver/5 bronze/2 excellence youth + 5 gold junior, among 30 countries (Ministry of Labor 2025). Dual-Track Training Flagship Program (modeled on Germany's dual system): work 3+ days/week, school 2-3 days/week, 2021 cohort employment rate 94.9% (Workforce Development Agency). 2023 starting salaries: senior-high/vocational ~NT$28,000/month, university ~NT$33,000/month, graduate school ~NT$49,000/month; share starting at minimum wage: 58.3% senior-high/vocational, 23.9% university, 4.4% graduate school (Ministry of Labor 112-year new-hire wage statistics, via Global Views Monthly).
